about_the_game:
Dive into the mind with the In My Brain soundtrack

The soundtrack of In My Brain accompanies the player on an emotional journey through the human brain. With compositions that blend immersive atmospheres and dynamic melodies, the music reflects the struggles and moments of hope faced by the protagonist, Nano, as he tackles mental challenges. From tense combat sequences to more introspective moments, each piece adapts to the emotions and environments of the game, creating a unique and profound experience.

Credits

Musical work composed by Indira Cardús.

name: In My Brain Soundtrack
short_description: In My Brain is a pixel art sci-fi action-puzzle game that follows Nano, a nanoparticle that infiltrates minds and fights against the mental health problems that haunt them. Learn about them and fight them from the inside!
